_note: Synthetic roles. Ids must match config/personas/expected.json. Every requirement has a follow_up_question, asked when a must-have can't be judged from the call.

roles.title: Junior React Developer
roles.summary: Building customer-facing web screens in React for a South African fintech. Fully remote within South Africa.

must_haves.text: At least one year of professional React development experience.
must_haves.follow_up_question: How long have you worked with React professionally, and on what?

must_haves.text: Willing to work fully remote from within South Africa.
must_haves.follow_up_question: Are you happy to work fully remote, and are you based in South Africa?

must_haves.text: Notice period of two months or less.

nice_to_haves.follow_up_question: Have you built anything customers use directly?

nice_to_haves.text: Interested in growing into backend work (Node.js, APIs).
nice_to_haves.follow_up_question: Would you like to do backend work, such as Node.js or APIs?

roles.title: Data Engineer
roles.summary: Designing and running data pipelines for a retailer. Hybrid, at the Johannesburg office two or three days a week.

must_haves.follow_up_question: How do you use SQL in your work today?
Which data pipelines have you built or maintained?

must_haves.text: Hands-on experience with a cloud data platform: AWS, Azure or Google Cloud.
must_haves.follow_up_question: Which cloud data platform have you worked on (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud), and what did you build there?

must_haves.text: Can work hybrid from the Johannesburg office.
must_haves.follow_up_question: Can you work from our Johannesburg office two or three days a week?

nice_to_haves.text: Wants to design pipelines, not only maintain them.
nice_to_haves.follow_up_question: Would you like to design new pipelines as well as run existing ones?

nice_to_haves.text: Five or more years in data engineering.
nice_to_haves.follow_up_question: How many years have you worked in data engineering?

roles.title: Operations Coordinator
roles.summary: Coordinating deliveries and suppliers for a growing tech company's warehouse operation. Hybrid, based in Pretoria.

must_haves.text: Experience coordinating operations or logistics, such as deliveries, drivers or warehouses.
must_haves.follow_up_question: What operations or logistics work have you coordinated?

must_haves.text: Has solved operational problems under pressure, with a concrete example.
must_haves.follow_up_question: Tell me about a time you fixed an operational problem under pressure.

must_haves.text: Can work hybrid or in the office in Pretoria.
must_haves.follow_up_question: Can you work from our Pretoria office at least part of the week?

nice_to_haves.text: Keeps operational reports or spreadsheets up to date.
nice_to_haves.follow_up_question: Do you keep any reports or spreadsheets for your work?

nice_to_haves.text: Interested in working at a tech company.
nice_to_haves.follow_up_question: What draws you to working at a tech company?
